name: hex_dump
description: Classic hex+ASCII dump with offset column (xxd-style format). Returns the dump as a single multi-line string plus a structured array of rows. Useful for visual inspection of binary data in a familiar format. The dump format is: 8-digit offset, hex bytes separated by spaces, optional ASCII column with '.' for non-printable characters.

address.description: Start address of the region to dump (default: 0)

size.description: Number of bytes to dump (clamped to data source size)

bytes_per_row.description: Number of bytes per row in the output (1-64, default: 16)

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to emit (1-100000, default: 256)
